div.div:
once: writing the same path twice in one run is an error · roots may not be nested (add_place) · "at the end" runs in do_jobs_at_end, only after a run that succeeded · the log folder is opened by Logme and is not a place
routing (process_result): the principal XML → intermediate; cpp2gal output → the output .gal place; @@alias@@relative@@ → the store with that alias; a relative path → intermediate; an absolute path → written directly

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
